name: PerpPair liquidity-matrix rounding and unsafe cast
summary: PerpPair's LONG trade path updates the liquidity matrix with divCeil while other paths floor, so repeated trades drift it; getLpLiquidityBalance then casts a slightly negative int256 to uint256 unchecked, wrapping to a huge LP balance. With flash-loaned USDC the attacker added one-sided liquidity, traded, and realised the inflated PnL from the Vault.
notes: The reset is Vault.initializeParameters, which set Vault.perpPair to this PerpPair 19 blocks after its deployment; Vault.addPnlToCollateral, through which the inflated PnL became withdrawable USDC, accepts only that address. Later fee (feeFrontend) and oracle parameter changes were not needed by the exploit.

Loss is the Vault's net USDC outflow in the exploit (225,647.74 out less the attacker's 60,000 deposited collateral). No other Vault outflow over its life exceeds about 1,900 USDC, so there is no earlier or follow-up exploit.
